exec(open(WORK/'build2.py').read())
lab=np.load(WORK/'labels.npy'); N=len(lab); folds=np.load(WORK/'folds.npy'); Y=np.eye(8)[lab]
F=dict(np.load(WORK/'prep_feats.npz')); A=np.load(WORK/'v2_layer_scales.npy'); abar=A.mean(0)
def oof_pred(X,lam):
    o=np.zeros((N,8))
    for f in range(5):
        tr=folds!=f; te=~tr
        mu=X[tr].mean(0); sd=X[tr].std(0)+1e-6; Z=(X[tr]-mu)/sd
        al=np.linalg.solve(Z@Z.T+lam*np.eye(tr.sum()),Y[tr]-Y[tr].mean(0)); o[te]=((X[te]-mu)/sd)@(Z.T@al)
    return o
acc=lambda o:round((o.argmax(1)==lab).mean(),4)
Xu=np.concatenate([F[p][:,KEEP] for p in ['m2','m6','m10','c12']],1)
Xs=np.concatenate([F[p][:,KEEP]*(A[:,k]/abar[k])[:,None] for k,p in enumerate(['m2','m6','m10'])]+[F['c12'][:,KEEP]],1)
for lam in [200,300,500]:
    ou=oof_pred(Xu,lam); os_=oof_pred(Xs,lam)
    # also: fit on unscaled, but evaluate with network's scaling (mismatch) -> emulate by fitting unscaled weights and applying to scaled features
    print(lam,'unscaled-consistent',acc(ou),'scaled-consistent',acc(os_))
# mismatch emulation: fit W on unscaled, apply to scaled features
lam=300; o=np.zeros((N,8))
for f in range(5):
    tr=folds!=f; te=~tr
    mu=Xu[tr].mean(0); sd=Xu[tr].std(0)+1e-6; Z=(Xu[tr]-mu)/sd
    W=np.linalg.solve(Z.T@Z+lam*np.eye(Z.shape[1]),Z.T@(Y[tr]-Y[tr].mean(0)))
    o[te]=((Xs[te]-mu)/sd)@W
print('fit-unscaled, apply-scaled', acc(o))
